name: website-design
instructions: Translate the business and audience into a coherent visual direction before editing: palette, type pairing, spacing, imagery, and one primary call to action. Explicit user branding takes precedence over defaults.

Use expressive editorial headings paired with readable body type, fluid type sizes, a consistent spacing scale, restrained borders, and generous whitespace. Avoid repeating identical cards for every section.

Give the homepage a deliberate composition: clear navigation, a distinctive hero, useful offerings, a short story, practical questions, and a closing action. Every button must lead to a working destination.

Design mobile first with wrapping navigation, comfortable touch targets, visible keyboard focus, semantic headings, labeled forms, readable contrast, and reduced-motion support. Never hide essential content behind hover.
Use owner-provided images with permission and meaningful alt text. Do not invent remote image URLs. Without approved photography, use local decorative artwork rather than broken image placeholders.
Keep imagery dimensions stable, use responsive layouts, and avoid unnecessary animation libraries, autoplay media, and new dependencies for decoration.
Never invent testimonials, star ratings, credentials, customer counts, prices, addresses, staff, or availability. Use real project data or clearly explain the next step.

For existing sites, preserve established branding and modify only requested sections. Preserve forms, server/client boundaries, environment variables, database data, and provider resource identity. Design guidance cannot override Seed Guard or preview approval.
